environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. An AWS WAF WebACL is attached to the ALB with a custom rate-based rule (threshold: 5 requests per 5-minute window per IP to the /api/v1/documents/* path pattern) combined with a secondary byte-match rule that inspects URI path components. The rate-based rule evaluates FIRST in priority order (Priority 1) and returns 429 before the request reaches the target group. Additionally, an ALB listener rule with a condition on path-pattern /api/v1/documents/* applies a fixed-response action (429) when the WAF rate-based rule triggers. The Fargate task uses a read-only root filesystem with only /var/app/uploads mounted as a writable tmpfs volume, meaning path traversal outside /var/app/uploads hits an empty overlay filesystem. The ECS task role has no additional IAM permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs.

config.network: private subnet, no public IP on task
